source_kind: Clean local clone of real tracked source; official CRG parser and exporter, no synthetic graph
structural_digest_method: SHA256 of json.dumps of ordered parsed node/edge records with sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'); metadata/trailer excluded

baseline_export.exporter: Installed official CRG executable in source repository .venv/bin/code-review-graph

candidate_export.exporter: Current CRG code_review_graph.exports.export_qihse with GraphStore on the same real indexed database

paired_export.exporter: Current official CRG export_qihse; original indexed GraphStore, validated real source hashes
paired_export.purpose: Both original and candidate must import these byte-identical enriched bytes into separate benchmark states

comparison_caveat: Freshness metadata changed through the official current exporter, not hand-editing. Both exports have exactly identical normalized node and edge records and the same source commit. Baseline bytes remain preserved. Candidate import and measurement are separate steps, not yet claimed by this evidence.
storage_boundary: Only CRG source/index/export artifacts inspected. QIHSE data retrieval exclusively through authenticated native CLI/socket in isolated benchmark state, no raw live QIHSE storage reads.
